title: Asian Pear and Cucumber Salad
shortDescription: Crisp Asian pear and cucumber are cut into matchsticks and tossed with rice vinegar, lemon, scallion, and a restrained sweet-salty dressing.
culturalContext: This is a contemporary Korean-inspired fresh salad rather than a traditional fixed dish. Pear variety, acid, chile, and herb additions vary; the descriptive Korean name requires review.
author: {{LEGAL_NAME}}

instructions.heading: Sort and wash
instructions.action: Rinse pear, cucumbers, and scallion thoroughly under cool running water, even though the pear will be cored.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Produce is clean with damaged portions discarded.
instructions.safetyNote: Use potable running water without soap or detergent.

instructions.heading: Dry and cut
instructions.action: Dry, core the pear, and julienne pear and cucumbers with a clean knife; slice scallion.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Pieces are dry and evenly cut.
instructions.safetyNote: Use clean ready-to-eat tools kept away from raw meat and seafood.

instructions.heading: Mix the dressing
instructions.action: Whisk vinegar, lemon juice, sugar, salt, and optional gochugaru until sugar dissolves.
instructions.safetyNote: Verify all packaged condiment allergen labels.

instructions.heading: Toss at service
instructions.action: Add pear, cucumber, and scallion and toss immediately before serving.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Ingredients are lightly coated and still crisp.

instructions.heading: Taste with a clean utensil
instructions.action: Adjust only after using a clean tasting spoon once; do not return it to the bowl.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Flavor is balanced without repeated tasting contact.
instructions.safetyNote: Use a fresh spoon for every taste.

instructions.heading: Serve immediately
instructions.action: Transfer to a clean dish and serve immediately; refrigerate if service is delayed.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: The salad is crisp and not watery.
instructions.safetyNote: Refrigerate at or below 40°F / 4°C and discard after unsafe holding.

grillSetup: Not applicable; this is a raw, ready-to-eat fresh side dish.
visualDonenessCues: Dressing is clear and lightly coats
foodSafetyNotes: Wash produce under cool potable running water without soap or detergent.
Use clean hands, boards, knives, bowls, and serving ware for ready-to-eat food.
Keep washed produce separate from raw animal foods and their tools.
Refrigerate at or below 40°F / 4°C and serve promptly.

allergens.crossContactWarning: No priority allergen is intentionally included, but verify packaged vinegar and gochugaru labels and prevent cross-contact.

substitutions: Use another crisp Asian pear variety only after checking ripeness and sweetness.
ingredientSourcing: Choose a firm fragrant Asian pear and crisp unwaxed cucumbers without soft spots.
makeAhead: Cut and dress immediately before service for best quality; dressing may be refrigerated 1 day ahead.
storage: Best served immediately. Refrigerate components separately at or below 40°F / 4°C and discard dressed salad after unsafe holding.
reheating: Do not reheat; this is a raw ready-to-eat dish.
leftovers: Avoid retaining table-exposed dressed leftovers; use only clean, promptly refrigerated portions.
servingSuggestions: Serve as a cooling side with spicy grilled foods.

faq.question: Should I peel the pear?
faq.answer: This draft keeps the washed peel; test cooking may revise the texture choice.

faq.question: Can it sit dressed?
faq.answer: Serve promptly because salt and acid draw water from the fruit and cucumber.

metaDescription: Make a crisp Asian pear and cucumber salad with rice vinegar and lemon, running-water washing, clean ready-to-eat tools, and prompt service.
